# Fernhill Tea Co. Shipping Policy

Fernhill Tea Co. is an online tea shop based in Vienna, Austria. We ship loose-leaf tea, tea bags and teaware from our warehouse in Vienna.

## Dispatch

Orders placed before 13:00 CET on a business day (Monday to Friday) leave the warehouse the same day. Orders placed after 13:00 CET, or on a weekend or an Austrian public holiday, leave on the next business day.

## Shipping within the European Union

- Standard shipping costs 4.90 EUR and takes 3 to 5 business days.
- Express shipping costs 11.90 EUR and takes 1 to 2 business days.
- Standard shipping is free for orders over 60 EUR. Express shipping is never free.

## Shipping outside the European Union

We ship to the United Kingdom, Switzerland and Norway for 9.90 EUR. Delivery takes 5 to 8 business days, and the customer pays any import duties or taxes charged on arrival. We do not ship to any other country outside the European Union.

## Tracking

Every parcel gets a tracking link by email within one hour of leaving the warehouse.

## Lost or late parcels

If a parcel has not arrived 10 business days after dispatch, write to us and we will open an investigation with the carrier. If the carrier confirms the parcel is lost, we send a replacement free of charge.
